name: @driftbox/app
description: Driftbox — a drum machine and step sequencer in the browser. Run it with npx @driftbox/app.
author: Louis Emmett
//: No runtime dependencies, deliberately. What ships is a prebuilt dist/ with everything already bundled into it, and a bin that serves it using nothing but Node built-ins — so `npx @driftbox/app` downloads one small package and runs, instead of resolving React, three and the rest first. That includes @driftbox/engine: it is compiled into the bundle at build time, so listing it as a dependency would make every user install a copy nothing loads.
